task.title: Read a run
task.shortdesc: The run detail shows the gate, the success metrics and every topic's result. Open a topic to see the difference, its reuse and the agent's work.

step.cmd: Open a run from Overview or Maps.

info.p: Pass means no topic failed a check. Fail lists the topics and the checks they failed.

step.cmd: Filter the topic table by status to find what needs attention.

info.p: The panel shows the DITA source beside the migrated MyST, the topic's reuse ledger entries, and, for a run with the agent, each attempt and its result.

step.cmd: Select Report to open the full migration report.
